user.title: Milk & More
user.description: Sign in with the email and password you use on milkandmore.co.uk. This is an unofficial integration that reads the website.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Milk & More again
reauth_confirm.description: Milk & More no longer accepts the saved password for {email}. Enter the current password.

error.invalid_auth: Milk & More rejected that email or password.
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach milkandmore.co.uk, or the website layout has changed. Check the logs.

abort.already_configured: This Milk & More account is already set up.

skip_deliveries.name: Skip deliveries
skip_deliveries.description: Skip the Milk & More deliveries on these dates, the same as the website's Skip Deliveries calendar. Days already skipped are left alone; days past the 21:00 cut-off are reported as too late.

unskip_deliveries.name: Restore deliveries
unskip_deliveries.description: Undo a skip: put the Milk & More deliveries on these dates back. Only works until 21:00 the night before.
